title: Exploring Acid-Base Titration Curves
description: Validator-clean Lab Studio definition for the custom Acid-Base Titration Curves experience. The dedicated route loads the teacher configuration and full comparative titration workflow.
learningGoals: Compare how strong and weak acid/base structure changes pH-volume titration curves.
Determine an unknown molarity from equivalence stoichiometry.
Use weak-system curve evidence to calculate percent ionization, Ka or Kb, and percent error.
safetyNotes: Wear splash-proof goggles and chemical-resistant gloves.
Review the instructor-provided SDS information for every assigned acid and base.
Add acid to water when dilution is authorized; never add water to concentrated acid.
Report spills immediately and rinse exposed skin with running water for 15 minutes.
Neutralize waste, test pH, and dispose only by the instructor's configured procedure.
